name: Pi: The Open-Source AI Coding Agent You Probably Haven't Tried Yet - DEV Community
description: Most coding agents are tied to one model provider. Pi normalizes across OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, and others at the API layer, so you can switch without re-learning a tool. If you already pay for Claude Pro or GitHub Copilot, pi can use those subscriptions directly — no extra API costs by default.
